title: Lesson 6: CDN & Edge Caching — js-tools
desc: Geographic distance is a physical constant: 1 ms per 100 km round trip, and HTTPS needs 2 RTTs before the request is even sent; the nginx edge tier measures 25x throughput with the origin only processing 4 out of 208,173 requests; no-cache still caches while no-store is the real do-not-cache; ETag and 304; proxy_cache_use_stale keeps the site alive when the origin is down but a never-cached URL still 504s after 6 seconds; and a cache key with a tracking parameter makes origin load jump 251x while every client-side metric stays unchanged.
